strategies.name: Detection Strategy for Temporary Elevated Cloud Access Abuse (T1548.005)

analytics.name: Analytic 1105
analytics.guidance: Multiple AWS CloudTrail events indicating temporary privilege escalation via PassRole and AssumeRole targeting newly created services or non-interactive infrastructure.

tuning.description: Define which roles are allowed to be assumed or passed; restrict highly privileged roles.
Time range between PassRole and AssumeRole events to link the privilege chain.
Restrict which services are authorized to invoke role passing (e.g., Lambda, EC2).

analytics.name: Analytic 1106
analytics.guidance: Token creation or access delegation where a user impersonates a higher-privileged service account or performs domain-wide delegation actions, such as GCP's serviceAccountTokenCreator or Workspace impersonation.

tuning.description: Tune based on legitimate service accounts allowed to impersonate user accounts.
Limit delegated access to specific scopes relevant to business functions.

log_sources.name: gcp:iam
log_sources.channel: PrincipalEmail with serviceAccountTokenCreator impersonating new identity

analytics.name: Analytic 1107
analytics.guidance: Detection of ApplicationImpersonation role assignment or delegated mailbox access to service principals or rarely used users, especially outside of normal hours or geographic norms.

tuning.description: Mailbox of interest where impersonation or access delegation occurs.
Tune based on expected application or script-based mailbox access.
Restrict based on corporate geography or travel expectations.

log_sources.name: m365:signinlogs
log_sources.channel: Unusual sign-in from service principal to user mailbox
